title: Large Scale Transfer Learning for Differential Privacy
summary: Turns our large-scale DP transfer-learning results — roughly 88% top-1 on ImageNet-1k at (epsilon=8, delta=8e-7) by privately fine-tuning only the last layer on pre-trained features — into an internal recipe, packaging the DP-Adam, DP-Newton, DP-LS, and DP-FC sanitizers and trainers for reuse.
